title: Checks for deprecated NumPy type aliases.
summary: NumPy's np.int has long been an alias of the builtin int; the same is true of np.float and others. These aliases exist primarily for historic reasons, and have been a cause of frequent confusion for newcomers. Ruff takes this rule from NumPy-specific rules and made it stable in v0.0.247.
message_templates: Type alias `np.{}` is deprecated, replace with builtin type

title: Checks for the use of legacy np.random function calls.
summary: According to the NumPy documentation's Legacy Random Generation: Ruff takes this rule from NumPy-specific rules and made it stable in v0.0.248.

title: Checks for uses of deprecated NumPy functions.
summary: When NumPy functions are deprecated, they are usually replaced with newer, more efficient versions, or with functions that are more consistent with the rest of the NumPy API. Ruff takes this rule from NumPy-specific rules and made it stable in v0.0.276.

title: Checks for uses of NumPy functions and constants that were removed from the main namespace in NumPy 2.0.
summary: NumPy 2.0 includes an overhaul of NumPy's Python API, intended to remove redundant aliases and routines, and establish unambiguous mechanisms for accessing constants, dtypes, and functions. Ruff takes this rule from NumPy-specific rules and made it stable in v0.2.0.
message_templates: `np.{}` will be removed without replacement in NumPy 2.0
